newsitem.title: USA: Digital to put AltaVista Web site in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Digital to put AltaVista Web site in Asia.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp said on Wednesday that it will establish one of its popular AltaVista Internet search sites in Asia.
The Asia site will provide users there with faster response to their AltaVista Internet search queries than by using the current site in the United States.
Digital said the site will be hosted at the Universiti Pertanian Malaysia-Malaysian Technology Development Corp (UPM-MTDC) Incubation Center in Kuala Lumpur.

AltaVista plans to expand the search service by establishing the AltaVista Woldwide Network and add additional sites in Europe, Asia, Australia, Latin America and Africa, managed by affiliates in each region.
Each affiliate will use the same index, search and retrieval software as the home site in Palo Alto, Calif. (http://www.altavista.digital.com).
To date, AltaVista has established two other mirror sites, in Northern Europe (http://www.altavista.telia.com) and in Australia (http://www.altavista.yellowpages.com.au).
